cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's separate what you saw from what you heard. Which part of the party do you know about?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake went over the balcony. Was that before you left?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a question about timing, not a fact. Who gave you a time?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. Your brother says there's a video.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have you watched it? 'Someone has a video' is not yet a witness statement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks about A departure; A3 evades by probing timing; B4 reported video causes A5 viewed-versus-reported distinction.

relationship.evidence: B2 reasonably wants chronology and B4 clarifies the limit of the report.

heightening.evidence: A5 addresses the newly disclosed potential recording without revealing anything A did.

specificity.evidence: A1 party and B2 cake balcony establish enough context for the guarded source inquiry.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 witness-statement correction is a pointed professional response to B4 report, not a general self-description.
